Round 2: built from Changan's own brand.

This round uses Changan South Africa's own assets from changanmotors.co.za: the ChangAnunitype typeface, Changan Blue, the 2026 "Driven to Evolve" campaign look, and official photography and colour cut-outs of the Uni-S, Deepal S07, Alsvin, CS75 Pro and Hunter.

Each concept below is a live mock-up of its opening screen. Move your mouse over them, click them, and watch them run.

Concept ARecommended

Evolution GalleryDriven to Evolve, in 3D

Changan's 2026 campaign already uses floating glass panels over a sunset reflecting pool. This concept turns that into the website itself: a 3D space of floating panels, each one a window into a model's world, with the car on the mirror floor.

  • Look forPanels drift at different depths. Some pass in front of the EVOLVE letters and some behind, and everything reflects in the floor.
  • TryMove your mouse to tilt the space. Click any panel and it expands to fill the screen as that model's world (Alsvin, CS75 Pro, Deepal S07, Hunter, Uni-S).

Arrive

Book

The panels fold into one. Your nearest Pretoria dealer and a test-drive form.

Why it works: it extends the campaign customers already see on billboards and social media, so the site feels like the ad come to life, and it's the most spectacular of the three. Watch-out: it needs a careful mobile version. On phones the panels become a swipeable stack.

Concept B

Drive-byThe car is the transition

Every change of scene is done by a car. A Changan drives across the screen at speed, and the next model's world is revealed in its wake.

  • Look forThe car's rear edge wipes in the next world, with motion blur and speed streaks. The model name changes as the car passes.
  • TryUse the arrow buttons (or your keyboard's arrow keys) to call the next car through. It also runs on its own.

Why it works: a simple, ownable mechanic that's always about the cars, and it works brilliantly on phones (swipe = drive). Watch-out: it needs a clean side-profile cut-out for every model. The site has them for four models; the Hunter needs one shot.

Concept C

Paint ShiftColour drives everything

The paint colour sets the whole page. Pick a colour and the world floods with it from your click, while the car is swapped for the newly painted one.

  • Look forA circular colour flood spreads from the swatch. The old car exits left and the new colour brakes in from the right.
  • TryClick the swatches. It also cycles through all five Deepal S07 colours on its own.

Concept C · live mock-up

Range

Why it works: it's personal, playful and very screenshot-able, and it uses assets that already exist. Watch-out: it's strongest on model pages. As the main home page idea it's less epic than A.

How they compare

A · Evolution GalleryB · Drive-byC · Paint Shift
Wow on first loadHighest: a 3D world straight from the campaignHigh: the car moving through is the hookMedium-high: wow when you click
Fit with the current campaignDirect continuation of "Driven to Evolve"Uses the campaign photographyUses the official colours
PhonesA swipeable panel stackExcellent: swipe = driveExcellent: tap a swatch
New assets neededPortrait crops (mostly already on the site)Hunter side cut-outCut-outs per colour for every model

My pick is A. It's the boldest home page and it continues the campaign people already know. B and C aren't wasted: B can become the line-up scroll and C the colour picker on each vehicle page, so you'd get all three signature moments in one site.

To decide, reply with A, B, C or a mix (for example "A, with B for the range section"), and tell me what to push further. "More dramatic", "warmer" or "bigger cars" is enough. Next I'll build the real home page in Next.js.

Images, logos and typeface are from changanmotors.co.za and are used here for internal concept review only. Prices and specs are as shown on the current site.
